messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Attached is the draft of your first witness statement for review. Please check the technical detail in paragraphs 7-9 (the capacity-fade figures and the thermal trips) and the procurement narrative in paragraph 4 - the more clearly we can show you told Calderhall about the energisation deadline and the revenue model, the better for the clause 11 argument. Mark up anything that isn't quite right and we'll finalise for the February exchange.

Sarah
